text:
irene: heads up, deploy-bot paused the canary promotion for tag=release-2026.05.14 — 2/4 staging canaries failed with build/test flakiness during promote.

deploy-bot: "promotion paused for tag=release-2026.05.14, reason=integration-tests/critical-suite x2 failures"

ci-runner: logs show intermittent checksum mismatch when fetching cached wheel/artifacts then subsequent overlayfs mkdir conflicts on workspace restore. snippet:
```
WARN: cache fetch sha256 mismatch for wheel: expected=aaabbb got=aaaccc
ERROR: overlay: failed to apply diff: input/output error
mkdir /workspace/test-2048: file exists
```

chris: looks like a bad cache layer combined with parallel runners reusing prefixes. We've seen similar when cache pruning overlaps restores.

sre-lina: no infra deploys recently. I'm seeing a spike in runner disk IO errors from hosts in pool-a at ~02:10 UTC. Opening ENG-3702 for runner-forensics.

release-mgr: change window closes in ~1h. Options: (A) pin to previous prod image (release-2026.05.07) and cut now, (B) wait and re-run canaries with cache-bust+serialized namespace, (C) extend window. Quick thoughts?

tom: pin is the safest to meet the window. Re-run will add ~25m and might still fail if runner disk issues persist.

irene: agreed, pin+followup. We'll schedule a serialized rerun tomorrow 09:00 UTC after ENG-3702 triage.

chris: for the rerun use env: `CI_CACHE_BUST=true CI_SERIAL_NAMESPACE=true RUNNER_RESTORE_RETRIES=5` — reduces blast radius.

deploy-bot: heuristic: recommend pin_previous_image when canary pass rate < 75% or infra-related IO errors detected.

release-mgr: decision: manual promote previous stable image release-2026.05.07. Noting in release notes and opening follow-up ENG-3702 (owner: sre-lina).

release-mgr: invoking deploy-bot: `promote --image=release-2026.05.07 --reason="canary-infra-artifact-cache-flake"`

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-runner: recommend blocking cache-prune jobs until we confirm runner pool disk health.

sre-lina: acknowledged, will pause scheduled prune for pool-a and collect diagnostics. ENG-3702 created and assigned to me.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Production tag now points to release-2026.05.07. :white_check_mark:

irene: added release note draft: "Production cut pinned to 2026.05.07 due to staging canary instability caused by artifact cache corruption and runner IO errors; ENG-3702 opened for follow-up."

chris: I'll queue a rebuild of the failed artifacts after ENG-3702 confirms runner disk health and then attempt a controlled promote.

release-mgr: summary: manual pin applied to meet change window; ENG-3702 follow-up owned by sre-lina; rerun scheduled for 09:00 UTC tomorrow with cache-bust and serialized namespaces. Close thread when ENG-3702 has initial triage. :lock:
